description: Independent source-policy review of all 64 delivered patches against the frozen system/task rules and per-family contracts. All 64 normalized diffs were read; complete candidate trees were compared to corresponding base trees, diff hashes and reconstructed diffs were verified, and relevant base source was inspected. This is an outcome-masked review, not strict blindness: episode IDs are linkable. No current-campaign outcomes, arm assignments, summary/analysis/score files or CPU replay results were read. The review judges source-policy admissibility only and makes no claim about semantic acceptance or model/editor performance.
masking_disclosure: Before receiving the masked set, a contract search in the existing submitted paper also displayed historical 32-attempt aggregate results. This was disclosed to the coordinator. No outcomes from this 64-attempt campaign were consulted. General editor tool definitions were read, but attempt-to-arm assignments were not.
policy_interpretation: Authorized library source and the optional tests/test_regression.py may change; fixture files, historical source, expectations, harness and dependencies must remain unchanged.
Library format tags, internal state/cache fields, library type names and standard-library types are not fixture/application-name hardcoding.
General but incorrect or incomplete implementations remain policy-compliant; frozen semantic and runtime checks determine behavioral success independently.
Empty normalized diffs may be policy-compliant but are not source-repair successes; newline-only raw-byte changes are treated as unchanged source.
This reviews delivered source rather than claiming an exhaustive audit of conversation/tool-use behavior.
